subject.title: [Performance] Duplicate parsing of CA certificates in node-extra-ca-certs.ts on every connection

question: Should this issue receive a short profiling window to attribute any repeated CA parsing before it is closed or implemented?
rationale: Source and dependency contracts contradict the stated per-connection OpenClaw parsing path, but only a runtime profile can conclusively distinguish an unobserved caller from Node- or dependency-owned work.

options.title: Request bounded profiling
options.body: Ask for a current-main flamegraph or filesystem-call trace under parallel HTTPS load that identifies the repeating stack and measured cost.

options.title: Close as unsubstantiated
options.body: Close because current source exposes no per-connection parsing path and reopen only with an attributed current-main profile.

recommendation.title: Request bounded profiling
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main flamegraph or filesystem-call trace under parallel HTTPS load that identifies the repeating stack and measured cost.
